# Keyboard shortcuts and mouse gestures

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_shortcuts.py - do not edit by hand. Regenerate with:
     python scripts/gen_shortcuts.py -o docs/guide/shortcuts.md -->

Everything here is also in the editor: **Help > Keyboard Shortcuts...** (F1) shows the same
table with a search field. Keys are written as on Windows; Ctrl is Cmd on macOS.

## File menu

| what | keys |
|---|---|
| New | `Ctrl+N` |
| Open | `Ctrl+O` |
| Save | `Ctrl+S` |
| Save As | `Ctrl+Shift+S` |
| Export Video | `Ctrl+E` |

## Panels

| what | keys |
|---|---|
| Bring forward (Up) | `Ctrl+]` |
| Delete the selected layer (Delete) | `Del` |
| Find (Find…) | `Ctrl+F` |
| Go to layer or preset (Go to layer or preset…) | `Ctrl+P` |
| Go to line (Go to line…) | `Alt+G` |
| Play / Pause | `Space` |
| Replace (Replace…) | `Ctrl+H` |
| Reset zoom | `Ctrl+0` |
| Send backward (Down) | `Ctrl+[` |
| Show or hide output | `Ctrl+J` |
| Zoom in | `Ctrl+=` |
| Zoom out | `Ctrl+-` |

## Canvas gestures

| what | keys |
|---|---|
| Select an object (again: the one behind it with Alt) | Click, Alt+Click |
| Add an object to the selection, or take it out | Shift+Click |
| Select what a rectangle touches | Drag on empty canvas (Shift: add) |
| Move the selection (Shift: one axis, Alt: no snapping) | Drag |
| Nudge the selection (Shift: 10 px) | Arrow keys |
| Scale / rotate the selected object | Drag a corner / the knob |
| Change a size, a line end or a text size | Drag a round handle |
| Move the anchor (Shift: snap); centre it | Ctrl+Drag / Ctrl+Double-click the cross |
| Select a part of an object; back out | Double-click / Escape |
| Cancel a drag | Escape |
| Zoom to the selected objects (the whole frame when none) | F |
| Zoom about the cursor / pan | Ctrl+Wheel / Wheel, Middle-drag |
| Bend a motion path; smooth or straighten a key | Drag a handle / Double-click a key |

## Timeline gestures

| what | keys |
|---|---|
| Move or trim a clip, move a key or a marker | Drag (Alt: no snapping) |
| Add a clip or a key to the selection, or take it out | Shift+Click, Ctrl+Click |
| Select the clips and keys a rectangle touches | Drag on empty space (Shift/Ctrl: add) |
| Select every clip and key | Ctrl+A |
| Move every selected clip and key together | Drag one of them (Alt: no snapping) |
| Move the selected objects whole | Drag a selected row's lifetime band |
| Delete every selected clip and key / keep only one | Delete / Escape |
| Scrub | Drag on the ruler |
| Apply a preset, add clips | Right-click a row |
| Show an object's properties as rows | Click the arrow by its name, Alt+Click the name |
| Key or unkey one property at the playhead | Click the diamond in its row |
| Show a property in the graph (Shift/Ctrl: add, remove) | Click its name |

## Animate gestures

| what | keys |
|---|---|
| Frame every key in the graph | A |
| Frame every key (the graph has the focus) | `F` |

## Transport

| what | keys |
|---|---|
| Step one frame back, forward | `Left`, `Right` |

## Code page

| what | keys |
|---|---|
| Run the code in the editor (apply it as one undo step) | `Ctrl+Enter` |
| Rename the chosen layer or preset | `F2` |
| Delete the chosen layer or preset | `Delete` |
| Find, replace, next match, previous match | `Ctrl+F`, `Ctrl+H`, `F3`, `Shift+F3` |
| Go to a line | `Alt+G` |
| Go to a layer or preset by name | `Ctrl+P` |
| Show or hide the output | `Ctrl+J` |
| Show or hide the explorer | `Ctrl+B` |
| Comment or uncomment the lines | `Ctrl+/` |
| Move the lines up, down | `Alt+Up`, `Alt+Down` |
| Copy the lines up, down | `Shift+Alt+Up`, `Shift+Alt+Down` |
| Delete the line; select the line | `Ctrl+Shift+K`, `Ctrl+L` |
| Zoom the code in, out, reset | `Ctrl+=`, `Ctrl+-`, `Ctrl+0 (Ctrl+Wheel)` |

## Full screen

| what | keys |
|---|---|
| Play or pause; one frame back, forward (Shift: ten) | `Space; Left`, `Right` |
| Start, end; repeat; mute; volume | `Home`, `End; L; M; Up`, `Down` |
| Leave | `Esc`, `F11`, `double-click` |

## Properties

| what | keys |
|---|---|
| Apply a multi-line field (LaTeX, code) | `Ctrl+Enter` |
